g.text: J1 pins 1–4 map to ULN2003 IN1–IN4 and Uno D2–D5. J2 pin 1 is external motor +V; pin 2 is common ground. Connect the motor to its matching driver socket.

g.desc: J1 pins 1–4 map to ULN2003 IN1–IN4 and Uno D2–D5. J2 pin 1 is external motor +V; pin 2 is common ground. Connect the motor to its matching driver socket.

g.text: Use the exact motor and driver ratings. Never power motor coils from Uno GPIO. Physical motor was not tested.

g.desc: Use the exact motor and driver ratings. Never power motor coils from Uno GPIO. Physical motor was not tested.
